d: Position: Basic Science Instructor (Physics, Mathematics, and Scientific Terminology)

We are seeking a dedicated and engaging Basic Science Instructor to join our educational team in Al-Kharj. The ideal candidate will design and deliver high-quality lessons that teach physics concepts, mathematical reasoning, and precise scientific terminology in a clear and accessible manner. This role emphasizes active learning, student engagement, and a supportive classroom environment.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Mathematics, Education, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Teaching certification or licensure preferred; relevant classroom experience in science or math education required.
Strong command of physics concepts, mathematics, and scientific terminology; ability to translate technical content into accessible instruction.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
Ability to work effectively with students, parents, and teammates in a culturally diverse environment.
Proficiency in Arabic and English is highly desirable.
r: Plan, prepare, and deliver comprehensive lessons in physics, mathematics, and scientific terminology aligned with curriculum standards.
Explain complex concepts using accessible language and real-world applications to students with varying levels of background knowledge.
Develop instructional materials, activities, and assessments that promote critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Assess student progress, provide constructive feedback, and maintain accurate records of achievement and attendance.
Differentiate instruction to accommodate diverse learning needs and provide additional support as needed.
Foster a safe, inclusive, and respectful classroom environment that encourages curiosity and collaboration.
Collaborate with colleagues to integrate cross-disciplinary activities and improve overall instructional quality.
Incorporate technology and educational tools to enhance learning outcomes and engagement.
Participate in professional development opportunities and contribute to school-wide initiatives.
x: Professional development opportunities and ongoing learning.
Supportive work environment with collaborative teams.
Health benefits and retirement plan, as applicable.

Please submit your resume, a cover letter outlining your teaching philosophy and relevant experience, and any supporting certifications to the indicated contact email. Include your eligibility to work in Saudi Arabia and your preferred start date.
